archetypes.name: clarify-parity
archetypes.rationale: Clarify fetch and publish token parity is the highest-risk behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Python clarify driver against the old shell contract. Focus on fetch token mapping, SUMMARY_OUTCOME emission, route-state fallback, invalid REQUEST_ID handling, and publish failure statuses. Check that missing sidecars stay benign while present unreadable sidecars fail as intended. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: wrapper-surface
archetypes.rationale: The retained shell entrypoint must remain launcher-compatible while delegating only once.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review design-clarify.sh and its harness for launcher compatibility. Check Bash 3.2 syntax, argv validation, session-env sourcing, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT fallback, and the rebuilt _delegate_args call to python/cli.py design clarify. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
